name: village-store-coins-v1
description: ⭐ THE ASSEMBLED VILLAGE STORE COIN, BOTH SINKS ON: the mint (rules.economy.storeCoinsPerCard 1), the shared recirculating supply (rules.economy.coinSupplyPerPlayer 5, so 10 coins at two seats and 20 at four), the Build sink with its n-of-suit half (rules.economy.coinPaysBuild and rules.economy.coinPaysSuitCost, both true) and the Grow sink with its full-building clause (rules.economy.coinPaysGrow and rules.economy.coinGrowOnFullBuilding, both true). V1 to V12 of docs/village-store-coins-2026-09-12-v2.md section 2, ruled by Dean 12/09/2026, ledger A150. ⛔ ITS CONTROL IS overlays/notice-board-visit-host-draw-by-seats-v1.overlay.json AND EVERY ONE OF THAT ARM'S TWENTY LEAVES IS PINNED HERE BY NAME. This file differs from the control in exactly the six coin leaves; the four meeple leaves are pinned at their shipped-off values so the delivery meeple cannot ride in as a passenger. ⛔ C100 IS STILL OPEN AND NO NOTICE BOARD ARM IS RULED IN AS THE SHIPPED GAME: the shipped default is still rules.turn.visitCurrency 'commons', so THIS IS AN ARM ON TOP OF AN ARM and every report header that quotes it must say so. The seat-shaped host draw is the best-performing configuration measured (5 PASS / 1 FAIL / 11 OBSERVE) and that is the whole of its claim to be the base; it is not a ruling. ⭐ WHY IT EXISTS: the barn parity trap strands about 11 cards per player per game (88.8% of the time a player holds barn cards that cannot afford any open tile, 84% of those one or two cards short), and played decks reshuffle 7 / 6 / 4 times a game off a 12-card deck, so stranded cards SHRINK THE CIRCULATING POOL. A card converted at the Store goes to the suit's discard and returns on the next reshuffle. RESHUFFLES PER PLAYED DECK IS THE CLEANEST FALSIFIABLE PREDICTION IN THE PASS: if the Store works, that number falls. Read it beside win rate by crop (Orchard 17.4% against Wheat 41.9%), own-crop build share against its standing 83%, the board mix with Apiary at 12%, and how often the supply is empty. ⭐ THE BUILDER DEFAULTS THIS ARM CARRIES, NAMED BECAUSE OF 05/09/2026 WHEN AN ARM BUILT FOR ONE PURPOSE CARRIED THREE UNNAMED KNOB CHANGES AND RULING IT IN RULED ALL FOUR. Dean confirmed the indicated reading on all of them on 12/09/2026 and ruled D7 explicitly. D1: cards paid into the exchange go to the SUIT'S DISCARD and never out of the game, because returning stranded cards to circulation is Dean's own best argument for the Store and out-of-game would do the opposite. D2: ANY delivery mints, including one bought by a Notice Board power, not only a main-action Deliver. D3: declining to mint is EXPLICIT, so the turn settles cleanly. D4: an empty supply mid-conversion STOPS rather than refusing the whole exchange. D5: a coin-Grow DOES fire 'when activated' abilities, which is the whole point of a Grow, and it is stated because V8 places no card and a reader may assume otherwise. D6: a coin does NOT count as a card for any card text that counts cards paid, the same family as the O17 fix. D9 has no subject here because no meeple exists in this arm. ⛔ WHAT MAY NOT BE QUOTED OFF THIS ARM. (1) THE BONUS RATE IS A SHARE OF TURNS AND NEVER PLAYS PER TURN. Judging the band on plays cost this project a re-run of five arms on 09/09/2026, and A Helping Hand's second play is about ten points of the difference. (2) NO LEVEL HERE IS COMPARABLE WITH A reference-v14 OR EARLIER NUMBER; only a delta paired on identical seeds against the named control is sound. (3) THE BARN GLUT READS +0.5 IDENTICALLY ACROSS THIS WHOLE FAMILY ON BYTE-IDENTICAL PER-SEAT LINES, so read the per-seat rows and NEVER the pooled median: four arms already disagree only in the pooled figure, which is an argument about the metric and not about the design. (4) The hand limit of 7 is the SIMULATOR'S bound (C7) and the table plays with none, so nothing here may be quoted as evidence about hand tightness in either direction. ⛔ C113, AND IT IS THIS ARM'S OWN TEST RATHER THAN BACKGROUND. docs/village-store-2026-08-19-v1.md section 1 tested this exact rider-on-Deliver placement and ruled it out: 'Free / a rider on Deliver. No cost, so it is always correct. Breaks everything.' Dean's answer of 12/09/2026 is that a valid delivery is a precondition and a capped, shared, contested supply of wilds that score nothing bounds the reward. THE CORE OBJECTION STANDS AS A TEST: if the arm shows every player converting every spare card every time, the August verdict was right and THE PLACEMENT IS WHAT TO CHANGE, not the price. Read the conversion rate and the empty-supply share together; a supply that never empties is a supply that is rationing nothing. ⚠️ TWO SEPARATIONS THIS FILE DELIBERATELY DOES NOT MAKE, and each has its own arm: overlays/village-store-coins-build-only-v1.overlay.json and overlays/village-store-coins-grow-only-v1.overlay.json hold the two bets apart, and overlays/village-store-coins-wild-only-v1.overlay.json turns the n-of-suit half off. IF THIS ASSEMBLED ARM READS BADLY IT CANNOT SAY WHICH HALF DID IT, which is exactly why the other three exist. ⚠️ AND IT CANNOT ANSWER C111 EITHER: only overlays/village-store-coins-and-meeple-v1.overlay.json can, because C111 is about the two new rules chaining. ⛔ EVERY PASSENGER IS PINNED BY NAME. THIRTY LEAVES. The control's twenty, unchanged and in its own order: rules.turn.visitCurrency, bonusTiming, selfVisitAllowed, hostDrawOnVisit, commonsTake, startingMeeplesPerColour, meepleAsCard, slotToll, meepleCapPerColour; rules.economy.noticeBoardThreshold, noticeBoardBlocks, unclaimedBoardsToCentre, noticeBoardsBySeats.2, .3 and .4, commonsColourMatch, commonsWildPair, endgameCoinCost, farmsteadCoinPower; and rules.turn.hostDrawOnVisitBySeats.4. ⛔ NOTE THE TWO COIN LEAVES AMONG THEM: rules.economy.endgameCoinCost stays null and rules.economy.farmsteadCoinPower stays false. THEY BELONG TO THE SEPARATE COMMONS-WITH-COINS ARM OF 10/09/2026 AND THEY ARE A SECOND MINT AND A SECOND SINK. Keeping them off is what makes rules.economy.storeCoinsPerCard the only faucet in the game, and every coin economy this project has had died of a second faucet or a pity rate. Then the six coin leaves that ARE this arm, and the four meeple leaves pinned OFF at their shipped values: rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace null (which means defer to the existing meeplesPerTile seeding and NOT 'no meeples'), meepleSpendTiming 'start' (the shipped value, and 'none' would delete a phase a named control replays against), meepleSpendPerTurn null (unlimited, the shipped idiom, and 0 would delete the phase) and meepleSpendDistinctColours false. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors, reference-v15 seeds), paired against the control on identical seeds. A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run. ⚠️ AND AS OF COMMIT e5aea08 ALL TEN NEW LEAVES ARE INERT: they exist in the data layer and no branch of play reads them yet, so this arm currently measures identically to its control. A run before the engine slices land proves the file parses and validates, and nothing else. ⛔ PINNED AT dairyGrowsBuilt 'none' ON 12/09/2026, WHEN THE BASE MOVED TO 'paidWild'. Every number published off this arm was measured BEFORE Dean ruled the Dairy board's follow-on Grow in, so the pin is what keeps this file reproducing what it measured. A new arm that wants the ruled rule should say so by name. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⛔ APIARY PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the Apiary board's retext in as the shipped default (apiaryPower 'deckGrowWild', "Grow a building using the top card of any deck", the deck card paying any activation cost). This overlay predates it, so apiaryPower is pinned here BY NAME at 'sow' (the S12 Sow 2) and it still replays its own game. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay sets its own meeple leaves and keeps them, and pins the two new leaves BY NAME at their off values (deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0), so it still replays its own game.
